_about: Speaking single-recording mode (the last prompt's package D, 2026-10-26), read by services/ai/single_recording.py. The academic lead's values - review = true until they are confirmed.
_max_minutes: The longest recording accepted per check, all pieces together; a piece that would pass it is refused.
_min_seconds_per_question: Shorter than this times the number of questions: the student is warned (and may still go on).
_min_answer_words: An answer the split gives fewer words than this makes the split uncertain, so the student checks it first.
